name: Gmail MCP
description: Multi-account Gmail on a Cloudflare Worker you deploy yourself: search and read mail, send, reply-all with quoted history, forward, attachments and inline images, drafts, labels, and threads. Each connection binds to one Google account and the refresh token stays in your own Cloudflare account.
author: mkpoli

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which Gmail account this connection is bound to (the connected account)

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search mail in the connected account with Gmail query syntax (from:, to:, subject:, is:unread, newer_than:7d, ...)

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read a full message from the connected account, including decoded body text

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a conversation thread from the connected account. Bodies share a total budget, so long threads come back summarized — read individual messages with get_message

includeBodies.description: false returns headers and snippets only

maxMessages.description: Newest messages are kept when a thread exceeds this

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List labels in the connected account

tools.name: modify_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels on a message in the connected account (also archives: remove INBOX; marks read: remove UNREAD)

tools.name: trash_message
tools.description: Move a message to the trash in the connected account (reversible for 30 days)

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft in the connected account without sending. With replyToMessageId the draft joins that message's thread, carries its threading headers, and derives recipients and subject from a reply-all when they are not given

htmlBody.description: HTML alternative shown by rich clients

from.description: Send-as alias already configured in the account

filename.description: Required with content; a staged file brings its own

contentType.description: Required with content; a staged file brings its own

content.description: File data as standard base64, for files small enough to pass inline

stagingId.description: A staged file from the stage_attachment tools, instead of content

cid.description: Content-ID referenced from the HTML as

contentType.description: Required with content; a staged image brings its own

stagingId.description: A staged image from the stage_attachment tools, instead of content

replyToMessageId.description: Gmail message id of the message this draft answers

quote.description: When replying, quote the original under the body

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Change parts of a draft in the connected account. Whatever is not passed keeps its current value — recipients, subject, text, files added in any client, and the thread the draft answers all survive the rebuild

body.description: Plain-text body; passing it replaces the readable text as a whole

htmlBody.description: HTML alternative shown by rich clients; needs body beside it

from.description: Send-as alias already configured in the account

filename.description: Required with content; a staged file brings its own

contentType.description: Required with content; a staged file brings its own

content.description: File data as standard base64, for files small enough to pass inline

stagingId.description: A staged file from the stage_attachment tools, instead of content

attachments.description: Omit to keep the draft's files; [] removes them

cid.description: Content-ID referenced from the HTML as

contentType.description: Required with content; a staged image brings its own

stagingId.description: A staged image from the stage_attachment tools, instead of content

inlineImages.description: Omit to keep the images the draft's HTML shows; [] removes them

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send an existing draft from the connected account

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft in the connected account permanently (drafts have no trash)

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List drafts in the connected account

tools.name: stage_attachment_begin
tools.description: Stage a file for the connected account outside tool arguments, for attachments whose base64 is too large to pass inline. Then either PUT the raw file bytes to the returned uploadUrl (curl -T <file> '<uploadUrl>'), which finishes the staging by itself, or send base64 with stage_attachment_append and seal it with stage_attachment_finish. Any attachments or inlineImages field then accepts {"stagingId": ...}

tools.name: stage_attachment_append
tools.description: Add base64 to a staged attachment in the connected account, in order, up to 1000000 characters per call

content.description: Standard base64; every chunk before the last must carry no padding

tools.name: stage_attachment_finish
tools.description: Seal a staged attachment in the connected account so messages and drafts can attach it by stagingId

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send mail as the connected account. For replies pass threadId plus the original's Message-ID header, or its Gmail message id, as inReplyTo

htmlBody.description: HTML alternative shown by rich clients

from.description: Send-as alias already configured in the account

tools.name: forward_message
tools.description: Forward a message from the connected account, quoting the original above its own headers

body.description: Your own note above the forwarded content

includeAttachments.description: Re-attach the original's files, within the attachment size budget

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Download an attachment from a message in the connected account. Returns base64 while it stays small enough to read; text types come back decoded

attachmentId.description: From the message listing; Gmail reissues it on every read

filename.description: Names the attachment when a message carries more than one

textOnly.description: Return only decoded text for text/* attachments, no base64

tools.name: untrash_message
tools.description: Restore a message from the trash in the connected account

tools.name: modify_thread_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels on every message of a thread in the connected account

tools.name: trash_thread
tools.description: Move a whole thread to the trash in the connected account (reversible for 30 days)

tools.name: untrash_thread
tools.description: Restore a whole thread from the trash in the connected account

tools.name: batch_modify_messages
tools.description: Add or remove labels on up to 1000 messages of the connected account in one call (archive: remove INBOX; mark read: remove UNREAD)

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a label in the connected account

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Rename a label in the connected account

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Delete a label in the connected account (messages keep their other labels)

localizations.name: Gmail MCP
localizations.description: 自分のCloudflare Workerで動かすGmailサーバー。メールの検索・閲覧、送信、全員返信（原文引用つき）、転送、添付とインライン画像、下書き、ラベル、スレッドを扱えます。接続ごとに1つのGoogleアカウントへ紐づき、リフレッシュトークンは自分のCloudflareアカウントから外に出ません。

localizations.name: Gmail MCP
localizations.description: 跑在自己Cloudflare Worker上的Gmail服务器：搜索和阅读邮件，发送，带引用的全员回复，转发，附件和内嵌图片，草稿、标签、会话。每条连接绑定一个Google账号，刷新令牌不出你自己的Cloudflare账号。
